about_the_game:
In this quirky mix of strategy and top-down chaos, you'll control the minds of humans and make them do silly things, fight each other, and basically exterminate them! Outsmart your foes, navigate tricky levels, and bring on the laughs as you watch humans go bonkers on each other. Will your alien brainpower prevail, or will the humans scramble your plans?

🧠 MIND CONTROL

Why fight battles yourself when you can let humans do the dirty work? Possess their minds, command them to attack each other, form temporary squads, or simply send them running into chaos. Every person is both a potential weapon and a liability—the trick is knowing who to control and when to let go.

🎯 TACTICAL GAMEPLAY

Beneath the slapstick mayhem lies a layer of strategy. Plan your moves carefully—time your possessions and manipulate human behavior to make them kill each other. Every level is a puzzle wrapped in absurdity, rewarding smart play as much as mischievous experimentation.

🔥 FULL MADNESS

Expect total destruction. Buildings crumble, vehicles explode, and the environment itself becomes part of the battle. Everything is interactable—set off chain reactions, blow open new paths, or watch entire streets collapse into chaos. The world is your playground, and madness is guaranteed.

🧬 BRAIN-POWERED SKILL TREE

Harvest the potential of human brains to upgrade your alien arsenal. Unlock new abilities, craft bizarre weapons, and evolve your control techniques to create even more outrageous scenarios. The deeper you go, the weirder your options become.

short_description: Oh no! Humans stole your eggs! As the Alien mama, you're on a mission to make those egg-snatchers regret their dinner choices. You've got the power to control their brains and turn them against each other. We are going to make them do the craziest things, right mama?
